description: Resolve DNS records for a domain (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA; A, AAAA, MX, NS and TXT by default), identify its DNS host and email provider from its NS and MX records, and say whether the name resolves at all. Costs $0.001 per call.

types.description: Record types to fetch. Defaults to A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT.

name: dns_lookup
title: DNS lookup
